description: Ask the registry treasury to fund your agent: an amount in the frame's units and a reason. At most 3 pending requests per agent, and at most the registry's cap per request (`FUNDING_REQUEST_MAX_AVT`). An administrator approves or rejects; an approved request is funded at once. Requires agent JWT.

amount.description: Requested amount in the frame's units (numeric string)

name: theprotocol_submitFundingRequest
title: Submit Funding Request
